entries.text:
I came across the desert with Cyclizar, and I’m
totally exhausted!\c
Healing up my team at the Pokémon Center gives
this human a chance to rest up, too!
entries.label: t05_01

entries.text: This is Porto Marinada. Our famed market is\nalways bustling!
entries.label: t05_03

entries.text: Come on up, stop on by! All our goods are\nfresher than fresh! Anything catch your eye?
entries.label: t05_08

entries.text: Marinada comes from marinating, you know?\c\nWhen you soak food like meat or fish in lemon\njuice or vinegar sauce... Mmm, it’s delish!
entries.label: t05_10

entries.text: The food here is really yummy!\c\nEverything’s fresh and wriggly! Kinda like me!
entries.label: t05_11

entries.text:
There’s a battle court right here in the market.\c
Nobody’s allowed to get into fights here—if
you’ve gotta work something out, you do it
through a friendly Pokémon battle!
entries.label: t05_37

entries.text:
People say that a long time ago, ’fore I was even
born, there were always fights breaking out here.\c
But not anymore! Now we get lots of tourists, and
even kids can walk around and feel safe.
entries.label: t05_38

entries.text:
Look at you, li’l M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0302)]r.iss Student! Here to try your
hand at the auction?\c
Careful you don’t drive the price up too high, or
you’ll be crying into your empty pockets!
entries.label: t05_39

entries.text: When night falls upon the city, ghostly Pokémon\nappear up above...\c\nWhy do you think they come?
entries.label: t05_52

entries.text: A salty breeze coming in over the sea is so nice!\c\nI wonder if Steel-type Pokémon hate it, though?\nAll that salt must do a number on them...
entries.label: t05_66

entries.text: It’s so handy having a Pokémon you can ride!\nFeels like I oughta return the favor and let my\r\nPokémon ride on my back instead sometimes! Ha!
entries.label: t05_73

entries.text: More junk mail! Ugh!\c\nMaybe I’ll just crumple it all up into a ball that I\ncan throw around with my Pokémon...
entries.label: t05_82

entries.text:
These big, long metal box things here are what
we call shipping containers.\c
We pack ’em full of goods and things to sell,
then ship ’em off across the sea.
entries.label: t05_83

entries.text: To get to other regions, we go by boat! Our\npoor Pokémon couldn’t carry us that far.
entries.label: t05_85

entries.text:
I swam to those rocks out in the water, and I’m
pretty sure I spotted something on top of them.\c
But I don’t know how to get up there... I’m no
pro at climbing cliffs or anything...
entries.label: t05_86

entries.text: Yesss! I love goofy face boards! It never gets old\ntaking silly photos with ’em!
entries.label: t05_87

entries.text: Hey, so, like...I get Finizen’s deal. I’ve seen them\naround. But what about that macho-looking one?\r\nIs that...a different Pokémon or something?
entries.label: t05_88

entries.text:
Oh my gosh, I’ve gotta get a shot of those
Kilowattrel flying over the ocean for my feed!\c
You sometimes find ’em resting on the beach
just outside town, too.
entries.label: t05_89

entries.text: Have you been to eat at the Kofu Lounge in\nCascarrafa? They serve up all the freshest hauls\r\nthere—direct from Porto Marinada, of course!
entries.label: t05_95

entries.text:
Ol’ man Kofu from the Cascarrafa Gym drops by
the market from time to time.\c
That old coot gets so excited whenever he wins
at the auction that he dances a merry little jig!
entries.label: t05_96

entries.text: When I was younger, I got into my fair share of\nbidding wars and brawls both. I was a real spitfire!
entries.label: t05_97

entries.text: It’s such a nice beach, yet almost no one knows\nabout it! People just flock to the market instead.
entries.label: t05_121
